Authors: Mikhail Izhutkin (mashingaan, @mashingaan)
-/
import Research.ProximityPrize.Frontier._IncidenceTripleMass
import Research.ProximityPrize.Frontier._IncidenceConstantLineCap
import Research.ProximityPrize.Frontier._IncidenceAverageAnchor

set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

namespace ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant

open ProximityGap.IncidenceTripleMass ProximityGap.IncidenceAffineLines
open ProximityGap.IncidenceConstantLineCap

/-- Constant line occupancy and the exact cube moment exclude a bad family. -/
theorem no_bad_witness_family_of_constant_budget
    {F I Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (gamma : I → F) (w : I → (Coord → A)) (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (d t : ℕ) (ht : 7*t < 3*(d+1))
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord) (htI : t+1 < Fintype.card I)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ C, (∃ B : Finset Coord, B.card ≤ d ∧ ∀ x ∉ B, z x = 0) → z = 0)
    (T : I → Finset Coord) (u0 u1 : Coord → A)
    (hwC : ∀ i, w i ∈ C)
    (hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t)
    (hwag : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ T i, w i x = u0 x + gamma i • u1 x)
    (hno : ∀ i, ¬ ∃ f0 ∈ C, ∃ f1 ∈ C,
      ∀ x ∈ T i, f0 x = u0 x ∧ f1 x = u1 x)
    (hbig : Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d+1) * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        (Fintype.card I * (Fintype.card Coord-t)) ^ 3 >
      Fintype.card Coord ^ 3 * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        (4*t*Fintype.card I^2+(d+1)*Fintype.card I)*Fintype.card Coord^2) : False := by
  classical
  have hpad : ∀ i, ∃ E : Finset Coord, (T i)ᶜ ⊆ E ∧ E.card = t := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨E,hTE,_,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
      (Finset.subset_univ ((T i)ᶜ)) (hcompl i) (by simpa using htn)
    exact ⟨E,hTE,hcard⟩
  choose E hTE hEcard using hpad
  have hcap : ∀ U D, (Finset.univ.filter (OnLine gamma w U D)).card ≤ 3 := by
    intro U D
    apply bad_witness_line_cap_three gamma w hinj Finset.univ C d t
      (by simpa using htI) ht hC T u0 u1
      (fun i _ => hwC i) (fun i _ => hcompl i)
      (fun i _ => hwag i) (fun i _ => hno i) U D
  have hcol := collinearTriples_card_le_square_of_line_cap_three
    gamma w hinj Finset.univ hcap
  have hpair : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I), ∀ b ∈ Finset.univ,
      a ≠ b → d+1 ≤ ((T a)ᶜ ∪ (T b)ᶜ).card+t := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    apply bad_witness_pair_union_distance gamma w hinj Finset.univ C d t
      (by simpa using htI) hC T u0 u1
      (fun i _ => hwC i) (fun i _ => hcompl i)
      (fun i _ => hwag i) (fun i _ => hno i) ha hb hab
  have hlow := triple_mass_lower_of_pair_union gamma w Finset.univ
    (fun i => (T i)ᶜ) (d+1) t hpair
    (fun a _ b _ c _ hab _ _ hnc =>
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (error_union_gt_of_noncollinear gamma w hinj C d hC T u0 u1 hab
        (hwC a) (hwC b) (hwC c) (hwag a) (hwag b) (hwag c) hnc))
  simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hcol hlow
  have hmono : (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (((T a)ᶜ ∪ (T b)ᶜ) ∪ (T c)ᶜ).card) ≤
      ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (E a ∪ E b ∪ E c).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro c _
    exact Finset.card_le_card
      (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.union_subset_union (hTE a) (hTE b)) (hTE c))
  have hlowN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord^2) hlow
  have hcolN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord^2*t) hcol
  have hmonoN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord^2) hmono
  have hupp := triple_union_mass_bound E t hEcard
  nlinarith [hlowN,hcolN,hmonoN,hupp,hbig]

open ProximityGap ProximityGap.SpikeFloor Code
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- A constant-line cube budget bounds the canonical bad-scalar census. -/
theorem badScalars_card_le_of_constant_budget
    {F Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord]
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (j d t : ℕ) (ht : 7*t < 3*(d+1))
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord) (htj : t < j) (hC : NoWeightLE C d)
    (hbig : Fintype.card Coord^2*(d+1)*(j+1)^3+
        ((j+1)*(Fintype.card Coord-t))^3 >
      Fintype.card Coord^3*(j+1)^3+(4*t*(j+1)^2+(d+1)*(j+1))*Fintype.card Coord^2)
    {δ : ℝ≥0} (hδ : δ * (Fintype.card Coord : ℝ≥0) < t+1)
    (u0 u1 : Coord → A) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ).card ≤ j := by
  classical
  by_contra hgt
  push Not at hgt
  obtain ⟨B,hBsub,hBcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ))
    (n := j+1) (by omega)
  let gamma : Fin (j+1) → F :=
    fun i => (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i) : F)
  have hinj : Function.Injective gamma := by
    intro a b hab
    have h1 := Subtype.val_injective hab
    have h2 := B.equivFin.symm.injective h1
    exact Fin.cast_injective _ h2
  have hbad : ∀ i, mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 (gamma i) := fun i =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hBsub (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i)).2)).2
  choose T hTsz hwEx hno using hbad
  choose w hwC hwag using hwEx
  have hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t := by
    intro i
    simpa using (witness_compl_card_le (j := t+1) (by simpa using hδ) (hTsz i))
  apply no_bad_witness_family_of_constant_budget gamma w hinj C d t ht htn
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Nat.add_lt_add_right htj 1)
    hC T u0 u1 hwC hcompl hwag hno
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hbig

open ProximityGap.Ownership
private abbrev sponsorP := ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.P
private abbrev sponsorG := ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.g
private instance sponsorPrime : Fact sponsorP.Prime :=
  ⟨ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.prime_P⟩

set_option maxRecDepth 4096 in
/-- Constant-line incidence at the literal first-sponsor cube-moment boundary. -/
theorem firstPrime_constant_incidence :
    ProximityGap.OpenCoreConditionalPin.WorstCaseIncidenceBounded
      (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1))
      ((221512373 : ℝ≥0)/(2^30 : ℝ≥0)) (2^30) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2^30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  let dom : Fin (2^30) ↪ ZMod sponsorP :=
    smoothDom sponsorG (2^30) ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.orderOf_g
  have hcode : ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1) =
      ((rsCode dom (2^29) : Submodule (ZMod sponsorP) (Fin (2^30) → ZMod sponsorP)) :
        Set (Fin (2^30) → ZMod sponsorP)) := by
    simpa only [dom,Nat.sub_add_cancel (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2^29)] using
      (evalCode_eq_rsCode ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.orderOf_g (2^29-1))
  intro u
  rw [hcode]
  apply badScalars_card_le_of_constant_budget (j := 2^30) (d := 2^29) (t := 221512373)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact rsCode_noWeightLE dom (by norm_num)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num

open ProximityGap.MCAThresholdLedger
open ArkLib.ProximityGap.Frontier.PrizeShapeRateHalfBracket

/-- The constant-line budget gives an unconditional canonical first-sponsor floor. -/
theorem firstPrime_constant_floor :
    ((221512374 : ℝ≥0)/(2^30 : ℝ≥0)) ≤
      mcaDeltaStar (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
        (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1))
        (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2^30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hbudget : ((2^30 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)/(sponsorP : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hb := natCast_div_le_inv_of_mul_le (E := 2^30) (Q := 2^128) (p := sponsorP)
      (by norm_num) ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.prime_P.pos
      (by norm_num [sponsorP,ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.P])
    rwa [epsStar_coe_eq_natCast_inv]
  have hgood : epsMCA (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1))
      (predecessorRadius (2^30) 221512374) ≤ (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hc := ProximityGap.OpenCoreConditionalPin.epsMCA_le_of_worstCaseIncidence
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1))
      ((221512373 : ℝ≥0)/(2^30 : ℝ≥0)) firstPrime_constant_incidence
    rw [ZMod.card] at hc
    have hpred : predecessorRadius (2^30) 221512374 =
        ((221512373 : ℝ≥0)/(2^30 : ℝ≥0)) := by norm_num [predecessorRadius]
    rw [hpred]
    exact hc.trans hbudget
  have hfloor := latticeBoundary_le_mcaDeltaStar_of_predecessor_good
    (F := ZMod sponsorP) (n := 2^30) (a := 221512374) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2^30) (2^29-1))
    (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) hgood
  convert hfloor using 1
  norm_num

end ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant

#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant.no_bad_witness_family_of_constant_budget
#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant.badScalars_card_le_of_constant_budget
#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant.firstPrime_constant_incidence
#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalConstant.firstPrime_constant_floor

/-- Triple-incidence mass excludes an over-budget family of canonical bad witnesses.
The support predicate is the unfolded minimum-distance bound for the code. -/
theorem no_bad_witness_family_of_triple_budget
    {F I Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (gamma : I → F) (w : I → (Coord → A)) (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (d t s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ C, (∃ B : Finset Coord, B.card ≤ d ∧ ∀ x ∉ B, z x = 0) → z = 0)
    (T : I → Finset Coord) (u0 u1 : Coord → A)
    (hwC : ∀ i, w i ∈ C)
    (hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t)
    (hwag : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ T i, w i x = u0 x + gamma i • u1 x)
    (hno : ∀ i, ¬ ∃ f0 ∈ C, ∃ f1 ∈ C,
      ∀ x ∈ T i, f0 x = u0 x ∧ f1 x = u1 x)
    (hbig : s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        s * (Fintype.card I * (Fintype.card Coord - t)) ^ 3 >
      s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 3 * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) *
          (s * Fintype.card I * (t + 1) ^ 2 + 3 * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
            s ^ 2 * Fintype.card I ^ 2 + 3 * s * Fintype.card I ^ 2)) : False := by
  classical
  have hpad : ∀ i, ∃ E : Finset Coord, (T i)ᶜ ⊆ E ∧ E.card = t := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨E,hTE,_,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
      (Finset.subset_univ ((T i)ᶜ)) (hcompl i) (by simpa using htn)
    exact ⟨E,hTE,hcard⟩
  choose E hTE hEcard using hpad
  have hlow := bad_witness_triple_mass_lower gamma w hinj Finset.univ C d t s hs
    hC T u0 u1 (fun i _ => hwC i) (fun i _ => hcompl i)
    (fun i _ => hwag i) (fun i _ => hno i)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hlow
  have hmono : (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (((T a)ᶜ ∪ (T b)ᶜ) ∪ (T c)ᶜ).card) ≤
      ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (E a ∪ E b ∪ E c).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro c _
    exact Finset.card_le_card
      (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.union_subset_union (hTE a) (hTE b)) (hTE c))
  have hmonoS := Nat.mul_le_mul_left s hmono
  have hlowN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord ^ 2) hlow
  have hmonoN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord ^ 2) hmonoS
  have hupp := triple_union_mass_bound E t hEcard
  have huppS := Nat.mul_le_mul_left s hupp
  nlinarith [hlowN,hmonoN,huppS,hbig]

open ProximityGap ProximityGap.SpikeFloor Code
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- Triple incidence bounds the number of canonical MCA-bad scalars. -/
theorem badScalars_card_le_of_triple_budget
    {F Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord]
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (j d t s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord) (hC : NoWeightLE C d)
    (hbig : s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) * (j + 1) ^ 3 +
        s * ((j + 1) * (Fintype.card Coord - t)) ^ 3 >
      s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 3 * (j + 1) ^ 3 +
        Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) *
          (s * (j + 1) * (t + 1) ^ 2 + 3 * (j + 1) ^ 3 +
            s ^ 2 * (j + 1) ^ 2 + 3 * s * (j + 1) ^ 2))
    {δ : ℝ≥0} (hδ : δ * (Fintype.card Coord : ℝ≥0) < t + 1)
    (u0 u1 : Coord → A) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ).card ≤ j := by
  classical
  by_contra hgt
  push Not at hgt
  obtain ⟨B,hBsub,hBcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ))
    (n := j + 1) (by omega)
  let gamma : Fin (j + 1) → F :=
    fun i => (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i) : F)
  have hinj : Function.Injective gamma := by
    intro a b hab
    have h1 := Subtype.val_injective hab
    have h2 := B.equivFin.symm.injective h1
    exact Fin.cast_injective _ h2
  have hbad : ∀ i, mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 (gamma i) := fun i =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hBsub (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i)).2)).2
  choose T hTsz hwEx hno using hbad
  choose w hwC hwag using hwEx
  have hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t := by
    intro i
    simpa using (witness_compl_card_le (j := t + 1) (by simpa using hδ) (hTsz i))
  apply no_bad_witness_family_of_triple_budget gamma w hinj C d t s hs htn
    hC T u0 u1 hwC hcompl hwag hno
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hbig

open ProximityGap.Ownership
private abbrev sponsorP := ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.P
private abbrev sponsorG := ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.g

/-- Canonical first-sponsor incidence at the integer triple-mass boundary. -/

      (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      ((210683555 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) (2 ^ 30) := by

  letI : NeZero (2 ^ 30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩

      ((rsCode dom (2 ^ 29) : Submodule (ZMod sponsorP) (Fin (2 ^ 30) → ZMod sponsorP)) :
        Set (Fin (2 ^ 30) → ZMod sponsorP)) := by
    simpa only [dom, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2 ^ 29)] using
      (evalCode_eq_rsCode ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.orderOf_g (2 ^ 29 - 1))
  intro u
  rw [hcode]
  apply badScalars_card_le_of_triple_budget
    (j := 2 ^ 30) (d := 2 ^ 29) (t := 210683555) (s := 56755)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact rsCode_noWeightLE dom (by norm_num)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num

open ProximityGap.MCAThresholdLedger
open ArkLib.ProximityGap.Frontier.PrizeShapeRateHalfBracket

/-- The triple-incidence budget yields a canonical unconditional first-sponsor floor. -/
theorem firstPrime_triple_floor :
    ((210683556 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) ≤
      mcaDeltaStar (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
        (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
        (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 ^ 30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hbudget : ((2 ^ 30 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / (sponsorP : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hb := natCast_div_le_inv_of_mul_le
      (E := 2 ^ 30) (Q := 2 ^ 128) (p := sponsorP)
      (by norm_num) ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.prime_P.pos
      (by norm_num [sponsorP, ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.P])
    rwa [epsStar_coe_eq_natCast_inv]
  have hgood : epsMCA (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      (predecessorRadius (2 ^ 30) 210683556) ≤
      (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hc := ProximityGap.OpenCoreConditionalPin.epsMCA_le_of_worstCaseIncidence
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      ((210683555 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) firstPrime_triple_incidence
    rw [ZMod.card] at hc
    have hpred : predecessorRadius (2 ^ 30) 210683556 =
        ((210683555 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) := by
      norm_num [predecessorRadius]
    rw [hpred]
    exact hc.trans hbudget

    (F := ZMod sponsorP) (n := 2 ^ 30) (a := 210683556)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
    (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) hgood
  convert hfloor using 1
  norm_num

end ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalTriples

#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalTriples.badScalars_card_le_of_triple_budget

open ProximityGap.IncidenceWeightedTriples

/-- Weighted triple-incidence mass excludes an over-budget family of canonical bad witnesses.
The support predicate is the unfolded minimum-distance bound for the code. -/
theorem no_bad_witness_family_of_weighted_budget
    {F I Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (gamma : I → F) (w : I → (Coord → A)) (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (d t s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s) (ht : 3*(t+1) ≤ 2*(d+1))
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ C, (∃ B : Finset Coord, B.card ≤ d ∧ ∀ x ∉ B, z x = 0) → z = 0)
    (T : I → Finset Coord) (u0 u1 : Coord → A)
    (hwC : ∀ i, w i ∈ C)
    (hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t)
    (hwag : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ T i, w i x = u0 x + gamma i • u1 x)
    (hno : ∀ i, ¬ ∃ f0 ∈ C, ∃ f1 ∈ C,
      ∀ x ∈ T i, f0 x = u0 x ∧ f1 x = u1 x)
    (hbig : s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        s * (Fintype.card I * (Fintype.card Coord - t)) ^ 3 >
      s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 3 * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
        Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 *
          (s * Fintype.card I * (t + 1) ^ 2 * (d+1-(t+1)) +
            (d+1)*(3 * Fintype.card I ^ 3 +
              s ^ 2 * Fintype.card I ^ 2 + 3 * s * Fintype.card I ^ 2))) : False := by
  classical
  have hpad : ∀ i, ∃ E : Finset Coord, (T i)ᶜ ⊆ E ∧ E.card = t := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨E,hTE,_,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
      (Finset.subset_univ ((T i)ᶜ)) (hcompl i) (by simpa using htn)
    exact ⟨E,hTE,hcard⟩
  choose E hTE hEcard using hpad
  have hlow := bad_witness_weighted_mass_lower gamma w hinj Finset.univ C d t s hs ht
    hC T u0 u1 (fun i _ => hwC i) (fun i _ => hcompl i)
    (fun i _ => hwag i) (fun i _ => hno i)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hlow
  have hmono : (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (((T a)ᶜ ∪ (T b)ᶜ) ∪ (T c)ᶜ).card) ≤
      ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (E a ∪ E b ∪ E c).card := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro c _
    exact Finset.card_le_card
      (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.union_subset_union (hTE a) (hTE b)) (hTE c))
  have hmonoS := Nat.mul_le_mul_left s hmono
  have hlowN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord ^ 2) hlow
  have hmonoN := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card Coord ^ 2) hmonoS
  have hupp := triple_union_mass_bound E t hEcard
  have huppS := Nat.mul_le_mul_left s hupp
  nlinarith [hlowN,hmonoN,huppS,hbig]

open ProximityGap ProximityGap.SpikeFloor Code
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- Weighted triple incidence bounds the number of canonical MCA-bad scalars. -/
theorem badScalars_card_le_of_weighted_budget
    {F Coord A : Type} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord]
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (C : Submodule F (Coord → A)) (j d t s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s) (ht : 3*(t+1) ≤ 2*(d+1))
    (htn : t ≤ Fintype.card Coord) (hC : NoWeightLE C d)
    (hbig : s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 * (d + 1) * (j + 1) ^ 3 +
        s * ((j + 1) * (Fintype.card Coord - t)) ^ 3 >
      s * Fintype.card Coord ^ 3 * (j + 1) ^ 3 +
        Fintype.card Coord ^ 2 *
          (s * (j+1) * (t+1)^2 * (d+1-(t+1)) +
            (d+1)*(3*(j+1)^3+s^2*(j+1)^2+3*s*(j+1)^2)))
    {δ : ℝ≥0} (hδ : δ * (Fintype.card Coord : ℝ≥0) < t + 1)
    (u0 u1 : Coord → A) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ).card ≤ j := by
  classical
  by_contra hgt
  push Not at hgt
  obtain ⟨B,hBsub,hBcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun γ : F => mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 γ))
    (n := j + 1) (by omega)
  let gamma : Fin (j + 1) → F :=
    fun i => (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i) : F)
  have hinj : Function.Injective gamma := by
    intro a b hab
    have h1 := Subtype.val_injective hab
    have h2 := B.equivFin.symm.injective h1
    exact Fin.cast_injective _ h2
  have hbad : ∀ i, mcaEvent (C : Set (Coord → A)) δ u0 u1 (gamma i) := fun i =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hBsub (B.equivFin.symm (Fin.cast hBcard.symm i)).2)).2
  choose T hTsz hwEx hno using hbad
  choose w hwC hwag using hwEx
  have hcompl : ∀ i, (T i)ᶜ.card ≤ t := by
    intro i
    simpa using (witness_compl_card_le (j := t + 1) (by simpa using hδ) (hTsz i))
  apply no_bad_witness_family_of_weighted_budget gamma w hinj C d t s hs ht htn
    hC T u0 u1 hwC hcompl hwag hno
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hbig

  ⟨ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.prime_P⟩

set_option maxRecDepth 4096 in
/-- Canonical first-sponsor incidence at the integer weighted triple-mass boundary. -/
theorem firstPrime_weighted_incidence :
    ProximityGap.OpenCoreConditionalPin.WorstCaseIncidenceBounded
      (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      ((214719987 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) (2 ^ 30) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 ^ 30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  let dom : Fin (2 ^ 30) ↪ ZMod sponsorP :=
    smoothDom sponsorG (2 ^ 30) ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.orderOf_g
  have hcode : ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1) =
      ((rsCode dom (2 ^ 29) : Submodule (ZMod sponsorP) (Fin (2 ^ 30) → ZMod sponsorP)) :
        Set (Fin (2 ^ 30) → ZMod sponsorP)) := by
    simpa only [dom, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2 ^ 29)] using
      (evalCode_eq_rsCode ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.orderOf_g (2 ^ 29 - 1))
  intro u
  rw [hcode]
  apply badScalars_card_le_of_weighted_budget
    (j := 2 ^ 30) (d := 2 ^ 29) (t := 214719987) (s := 56756)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact rsCode_noWeightLE dom (by norm_num)
  · norm_num
  · norm_num

open ProximityGap.MCAThresholdLedger
open ArkLib.ProximityGap.Frontier.PrizeShapeRateHalfBracket

/-- The weighted triple-incidence budget yields a canonical unconditional first-sponsor floor. -/
theorem firstPrime_weighted_floor :
    ((214719988 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) ≤
      mcaDeltaStar (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
        (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
        (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 ^ 30 : ℕ) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hbudget : ((2 ^ 30 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / (sponsorP : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hb := natCast_div_le_inv_of_mul_le
      (E := 2 ^ 30) (Q := 2 ^ 128) (p := sponsorP)
      (by norm_num) ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.prime_P.pos
      (by norm_num [sponsorP, ArkLib.ProximityGap.PrizeShapePrimeP30.P])
    rwa [epsStar_coe_eq_natCast_inv]
  have hgood : epsMCA (F := ZMod sponsorP) (A := ZMod sponsorP)
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      (predecessorRadius (2 ^ 30) 214719988) ≤
      (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hc := ProximityGap.OpenCoreConditionalPin.epsMCA_le_of_worstCaseIncidence
      (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
      ((214719987 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) firstPrime_weighted_incidence
    rw [ZMod.card] at hc
    have hpred : predecessorRadius (2 ^ 30) 214719988 =
        ((214719987 : ℝ≥0) / (2 ^ 30 : ℝ≥0)) := by
      norm_num [predecessorRadius]
    rw [hpred]
    exact hc.trans hbudget
  have hfloor := latticeBoundary_le_mcaDeltaStar_of_predecessor_good
    (F := ZMod sponsorP) (n := 2 ^ 30) (a := 214719988)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (ArkLib.ProximityGap.KKH26.evalCode sponsorG (2 ^ 30) (2 ^ 29 - 1))
    (ProximityGap.epsStar : ℝ≥0∞) hgood
  convert hfloor using 1
  norm_num

end ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalWeighted

#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalWeighted.badScalars_card_le_of_weighted_budget

#print axioms ProximityGap.IncidenceCanonicalWeighted.firstPrime_weighted_floor
